name: Flocksy
whyThisMatters:
What you buy is hours, not a pile of requests. Flat monthly rate. Hours you don't use stick around for 30 days instead of vanishing. Video, motion, and illustration all come out of the same pool. They say you can cancel anytime, and there's no contract.

It's a small team with jobs, not a ticket that lands on whoever is free. A designer, a video editor, a motion editor, an illustrator. AI is the stuff behind them so the work moves faster. Their line is human-made, AI-accelerated, and they've been doing it since 2016.

They say a first request can go in within a day, and every minute gets tracked against the rate. The 30-day bank is what keeps it from feeling like a gym membership. You can see the time you didn't spend.

They point at G2 and Trustpilot, and at how many files and projects they've shipped since 2016. Those counts come from their own platform. They're talking about the work, not about a payment processor.

The useful bit for whoever pays the bill is the rate card. You know the hours, you know they roll for a month, you know video isn't a surprise add-on. That's easier to explain than "unlimited requests," which always has a catch somewhere in the terms. One pool of hours, several kinds of creative work.
